meta.scope: Turkey Batch 2 — Labour market, industrial production, tourism, and EU Customs Union densification.

candidates.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
candidates.description: Official labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates (including seasonally adjusted series). Recent unemployment has fallen to multi-year lows in the mid-to-high single digits; youth and female rates remain structurally higher.
candidates.notes: Primary labour-market statistical product. High-frequency series.

candidates.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
candidates.description: Monthly industrial production index and manufacturing output. Manufacturing dominates industrial activity (food, basic metals, motor vehicles, textiles, chemicals, electrical equipment, apparel, etc.). Closely watched as a high-frequency activity indicator.

candidates.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
candidates.publisher: TurkStat / Ministry of Culture and Tourism related
candidates.description: Official statistics on international visitor arrivals and tourism receipts. Tourism is a major services credit in the balance of payments; recent years show arrivals in the 60+ million range and revenues above USD 60 billion.

candidates.title: EU–Türkiye Customs Union framing
candidates.description: Customs Union (in force since end-1995) covering industrial goods and providing deep preferential access. The EU is Türkiye’s largest trade partner by a wide margin (roughly 40%+ of exports and a large share of imports). Continuously cited in trade, industrial and accession analysis.
candidates.notes: Foundational external-trade architecture node. Highest-centrality bilateral frame for Turkey.

candidates.title: Türkiye–EU merchandise trade statistics
candidates.publisher: TurkStat / Ministry of Trade / Eurostat related
candidates.description: Bilateral goods trade with the European Union under the Customs Union. Motor vehicles, machinery, electrical equipment and related manufactures dominate both directions. Bilateral trade volume has exceeded €200 billion in recent years.
candidates.notes: Quantitative densification of the EU trade corridor.

candidates.title: Turkey labour–industry–tourism–EU densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from TurkStat, CBRT and EU sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding labour force and unemployment statistics, industrial production, tourism arrivals and revenue, EU–Türkiye Customs Union framing, and Türkiye–EU merchandise trade into a coherent activity–services–external layer.
